role: Graduate civil engineer or civil design support - expression of interest (Melbourne)
subject: Graduate civil engineer or civil design support EOI, Melbourne, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

This is a speculative enquiry, not a reply to a named vacancy. Your careers page invites people interested in joining Team DCE to get in touch at hr@dceng.com.au, so I am writing about graduate civil engineering or civil design support work in Melbourne.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as project-in-charge and field engineer.

I am Melton based, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for office, site and regional work. I do not yet have Australian consulting employment, so mentoring on civil design or delivery work is what I am looking for.

Your Richmond civil and water engineering practice is the reason I am writing. I have attached my resume and cover letter. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com

paragraphs: This is a speculative enquiry. Your careers page asks people interested in joining Team DCE to contact hr@dceng.com.au. I am interested in graduate civil engineering or civil design support with your Melbourne team, especially road, drainage, earthworks and land development work.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute. Coursework covered road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage, with drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards, plus Before You Dig Australia enquiries. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019).

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines: project-in-charge on a community hall renovation (about 10 to 15 workers a day, drawing reviews, inspections and quality checks), then field engineer on subdivision finishing works (site reports, material records and coordination with engineers and suppliers).

I live in Melton, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for office, site and regional work. I do not yet have Australian consulting employment, so I am looking for a team that can mentor me on live civil design and delivery.
I have attached my resume and a short cover letter. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. Thank you for considering this enquiry.
